Name: Possessive Sebastian Dialogue Expansion Pack-- Rewrite of Isa's Yandere Sebastian Expansion Pack
Author: thelittlefae
Description:
[center][u]
[/u][u][b][size=4]WHAT THIS MOD DOES[/size]
[/b][/u]
[size=3]I wanted my Seb to be mentally well but still have some spice and obsession. That's what I've made.[/size]
[size=3] I edited a lot of the lines of Isa's work to make a "soft version"[/size]
[size=3]that fit my idea of Seb, he's possessive, controlling and obsessed with[/size]
[size=3]you.. but a lot less scary and a lot more romantic.[/size][size=3]
[/size]
[size=3]This is my first mod, and I just made it for myself. So please be nice. Oh and[/size]
[size=3]it works for either gender![/size]
[b][u][size=4]
Description[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]By "soft version" I mean he's possessive, protective, controlling and obsessed. In Isa's[/size]
[size=3]mod there's animal cruelty, knives and he generally goes downhill[/size]
[size=3]mentally when you come to Stardew Valley. I started to rewrite just a few things so it's a little less concerning and went a lil overboard and somehow it became it's own mod.[/size][size=3]
This mod is not in the horror genre: there[/size]
[size=3]is no animal cruelty, no knives, and everybody just thinks he really, really[/size]
[size=3]likes you. Maybe a little too much. It might be a bit obsessive but hey, romance novels and all that jazz.[/size]

[size=3]There is special dialogue for receiving a bouquet, and a sweet surprise when you give him a[/size]
[size=3]mermaid's pendant. [/size]
[size=3]There's special festival dialogue, spouse and pre-marriage dialogue. Like lots[/size]
[size=3]of dialogue, over 200 lines. 
[/size]
[size=4][b][u]FEATURES[/u][/b][b][u]:[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]- over 200 lines of both pre-marriage and post marriage dialogue, and festival[/size]
[size=3]dialogue.[/size]
[size=3]- unique lines for when you've divorce or are rejected[/size]
[size=3]by Sebastian[/size]
[size=3]- Robin, along with bachelors and bachelorettes around Sebastian's age group[/size]
[size=3]will comment on his behavior during the different seasons.[/size]
[size=3]- unique lines for receiving a bouquet or a mermaid's pendant.[/size]


[size=3]I forgot to take pictures so: 
[/size]
[b][u][size=4]Dialogue Content Examples [/size]
[/u][/b]
[size=2][color=#d5a6bd]Living on a farm with you is a dream. can't even imagine being without you. Even thinking about it makes
me kinda sad."[/color]

The last day of the year, huh... Well, it's been one of the happiest years of my life, thanks to you. We
should celebrate a bit. Care for a drink? Let's make the most of tonight.

[color=#d5a6bd]You should come with me to the lake sometime. It's really beautiful at night. It can be a date[/color]

Woah, wait a sec. You have a cut on your cheek. Let me help...Who did this to you? Tell me now.

[color=#d5a6bd]Are you cold? I'll keep you warm...Come here.[/color]

Hey. How are you? I noticed you went to bed pretty late last night. Make sure you get enough sleep.",

        [color=#d5a6bd] You know, you're so cute that I'm scared someone would try something on you. I want
people to know that you belong to me, not them[/color]
 
Are you friends with Sam, too? I saw you talking to him...

[color=#d5a6bd](and some marriage lines, these are usually more possessive): The night market comes to town tomorrow. They always have all kinds of strange things for sale. Hm, do you want me to come with you? I don't want you to get kidnapped.. What? You're so beautiful anyone would want to own you, but you're mine and only mine.
[/color]
My perfect angel. There's something so special about something you love coming to you, instead of having to lock it up. Don't look sad love, I'll still lock you up whenever you want...[/size]
[b]
HOW TO INSTALL [/b]

[size=4]STEP 1:  * Install both SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size]
[size=4]* Extract/Open this file with either Winrar or 7zip.[/size]
[size=4]* Copy the folder named "[CP] Yandere Sebastian Dialogue Expansion"[/size]
[size=4]and paste it into your Mods folder, NOT the Content Patcher folder.[/size]
[size=4]STEP 2 (optional): * Install MissCoriel's NPC Unique Courtship[/size]
[size=4]response[/size]
[size=4]* Open "config.json" and change Sebastian's setting from[/size]
[size=4]"enabled" to "disabled" to see the unique pendant/bouquet[/size]
[size=4]dialogues


[b]INSTALL METHOD USING VORTEX MOD MANAGER[/b]
[size=3]STEP 1: install Vortex and follow steps[/size]
[size=3]STEP 2: Install SMAPI-- Guide to using smapi with vortex here:[/size]
[size=3]( https://wiki.nexusmods.com/index.php/Modding_Stardew_Valley_with_Vortex [/size][size=3])[/size]
[size=3]STEP 3: Install Content Patcher[/size]
[size=3]STEP 4: Install MissCoriel's NPC Unique Courtship response ( https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3312 [/size][size=3])[/size]
[size=3]STEP 5: In the config file of Install MissCoriel's NPC Unique[/size]
[size=3]Courtship response, set Sebastian to "Disabled". This allows this mod[/size]
[size=3]to overwrite it[/size]
[size=3]STEP 6: Install this mod.

[/size][/size]
[u][b]Compatibility:[/b][/u][size=3]
[/size][size=3]-It's edited to work with Mal's Sebastian Expansion with Post Marriage, and with Canon friendly out of the box
-Really anything that doesn't overwrite this work, which is anything that doesn't majorly overhaul Sebby

Many compatibility questions have been answered in comments, 
[/size][b]Please check there before asking if things are compatible. I won't be answering repeat questions[/b]
